description: Government Polytechnic Kursi Road, Barabanki is a government polytechnic established in 2013 at Kursi Road near Amroon Food Factory in Fatehpur, Barabanki, Uttar Pradesh. The official site states that the campus covers 5 acres and offers three-year diploma courses.
